skill.summary: Identify and reduce high bounce rates by segmenting traffic, fixing message mismatch, improving page speed, adding scroll cues, and analyzing bounce quality.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of cro-bounce-rate skill:

- Introduces a systematic approach for reducing high bounce rates on web pages.
- Emphasizes segmenting bounce rate data before optimization.
- Recommends fixing message match and page speed before copy changes.
- Provides tactics for encouraging user engagement (scroll-inducing elements).
- Explains how to distinguish between dissatisfied bounces and satisfied exits using scroll depth.
- Includes a quick reference chart and lists common mistakes to avoid.
- Invites users to validate changes with Racoonn AI-simulated user testing.
